outcome: Vitamin D status (25(OH)D levels) in pregnant women and their offspring
cohort: 291 pregnant Black South African women and their healthy neonates
finding: Among Black South African women delivering in Johannesburg, about one in six mothers and one in three neonates have 25(OH)D levels indicative of vitamin D deficiency.
mod_finding: Neonates born by caesarean section were more likely to have VDD.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with neonatal vitamin D deficiency.
